observations: Huang et al., Clinical Cancer Research 2017; DOI:10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-16-0863. Integrated epigenomic analysis identified a cervical-scraping DNA methylation panel for endometrial cancer detection.

entities.name: Two-of-three methylation panel
observations: In 146 cervical scrapings (50 endometrioid endometrial cancers, 40 uterine myomas, 56 healthy controls), any two of BHLHE22, CDO1, and CELF4 yielded 91.8% sensitivity, 95.5% specificity, and OR 236.3 (95% CI 56.4–989.6).
The three genes were selected after integrated analysis of two methylomics databases and QMSP validation; the study also detected markers in 13 of 14 type II cases.
